name: v35_ebit_actual_consensus_improvement
hypothesis: Companies whose reported EBIT is improving relative to the current-quarter consensus may benefit from post-report underreaction without relying on EPS yield or accounting payout anchors.
notes: Primary new direction: actual-vs-consensus EBIT surprise/improvement; no close/open, EPS yield, sales dispersion, graph, credit capacity, or earnings news.

name: v35_ebitda_actual_agreement
hypothesis: Reported EBITDA above consensus, especially when estimate dispersion is low, can capture cleaner operating surprise with lower overlap to raw analyst-yield alphas.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(ebitda_reported_value / ebitda_median, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(ebitda_reported_value / ebitda_median, 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ebitda_stddev / abs(ebitda_median), 126), industry)
notes: Uses reported-vs-median surprise and low disagreement, avoiding EBITDA/EV yield that is already crowded.

name: v35_netprofit_actual_consensus_breadth
hypothesis: Net profit actuals above current-quarter consensus with broad analyst participation may identify resilient earnings delivery after uncertainty resolves.
notes: Net-profit actual surprise, distinct from adjusted-income range rescue that correlated with akdb1ZqR.

name: v35_pretax_actual_low_dispersion
hypothesis: Pretax profit delivery versus consensus may capture operating and tax-neutral earnings surprise; low pretax dispersion is a stabilizer rather than the main signal.
notes: Pretax actual/estimate surprise; tests a non-sales analyst actual channel.

name: v35_gross_income_actual_margin_surprise
hypothesis: Gross-income beats relative to consensus can reflect margin resilience before it appears in broader profitability-yield factors.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(gross_income_reported_value / gross_income_avg, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(gross_income_reported_value / gross_income_avg, 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * stddev_gross_income_quarterly_estimate / abs(gross_income_avg), 126), industry)
notes: Gross-income actual surprise; lower coverage but less direct overlap with existing sales-dispersion ACTIVE.

name: v35_reported_eps_surprise_risk_relief
hypothesis: Reported EPS beats with low estimate dispersion and improving market-risk state may work as an earnings delivery signal, but it is a control because EPS channels can collide with akd1nQMW.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(earnings_per_share_reported_value / eps_reported_median, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * stddev_reported_eps_quarterly_estimate / abs(eps_reported_median), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Control candidate; submit only if correlation to EPS/yield ACTIVE names is safely below gate.

name: v35_sales_actual_surprise_without_dispersion
hypothesis: Sales actuals above consensus may be a cleaner actual-surprise route than dispersion resolution, but this is a control because akdb1ZqR already occupies sales uncertainty.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 63), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Sales surprise control; reject if it maps to akdb1ZqR or sales-count/dispersion path.

name: v35_netprofit_actual_subindustry
hypothesis: A tighter subindustry comparison for net-profit actual surprise may reduce sector accounting mix and improve sub-universe stability.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_qf_nd_netprofit_value / anl4_fs_detail_estimate_1qf_v4_nd_netprofit_mean, 126), subindustry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * net_income_stddev / abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_1qf_v4_nd_netprofit_mean), 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), subindustry)
notes: Only deliberate group variant in v35; tests whether net-profit actual surprise survives a stricter peer set.
